description: This file contains client-side scripts for the 'Delivery Note' doctype in ERPNext, including setup, UI interactions, custom buttons, and class definitions for delivery note operations.

classes.name: erpnext.stock.DeliveryNoteController
classes.description: Controller class for managing delivery note operations, extending erpnext.selling.SellingController.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for delivery note form, including query setups and UI properties.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the delivery note form, adding buttons and updating UI based on document status.

methods.name: make_shipment
methods.description: Creates a shipment from the delivery note.

methods.name: make_sales_invoice
methods.description: Creates a sales invoice from the delivery note.

methods.name: make_installation_note
methods.description: Creates an installation note from the delivery note.

methods.name: make_sales_return
methods.description: Creates a sales return from the delivery note.

methods.name: make_delivery_trip
methods.description: Creates a delivery trip from the delivery note.

methods.name: items_on_form_rendered
methods.description: Handles rendering of items on the form, setting up serial or batch numbers.

methods.name: packed_items_on_form_rendered
methods.description: Handles rendering of packed items, setting up serial or batch numbers.

methods.name: close_delivery_note
methods.description: Updates the delivery note status to 'Closed'.

methods.name: reopen_delivery_note
methods.description: Reopens a closed delivery note, setting status to 'Submitted'.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the delivery note status via server call.
